_comment: Exactly one override, on one plant at one retailer.
That shape is the point. build_price_table() decides whether a link is an
affiliate link by asking this file, so the fixture has to contain a page
that HAS one (test-hydrangea) and pages that do NOT (test-maple,
test-apple). Without both, 'marks the affiliate link' and 'marks every
retailer' would pass identically, which is the bug that shipped: the
asterisk was driven off retailers.json research notes and marked seven
retailers that pay the site nothing.
